backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Pristine Learning backend, defining data types (bookings, users, teachers, reviews, messages, withdrawals) and persistent storage maps, with Stripe payment integration, access control mixins, and blob storage support.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing short summaries of each frontend source file, describing recent changes and functionality for pages, components, and utilities in the Pristine Learning app.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS entry file that defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including colors for background, foreground, primary, sidebar, and chart tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite-based frontend, mounting the React app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application file that sets up TanStack Router with all page routes (including alias redirects for legacy paths), wraps the app in QueryClient/ThemeProvider/LanguageProvider, and renders a shared RootLayout with Navbar and Footer.
frontend/src/components/BookingModal.tsx: Modal component for booking demo or paid sessions with a teacher, generating time slots for the next 5 days, saving bookings to local store, and sending notifications to both student and teacher.
Shared dashboard layout component providing a responsive sidebar with role-specific navigation items (admin, teacher, student), notification badge, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/DemoModeBanner.t: Displays a dismissible amber banner indicating the user is in Admin Demo Mode, with an option to exit demo mode by clearing local/session storage and navigating to the home page.
frontend/src/components/DemoModeButton.t: Provides a UI button and helper functions to enter a local-only admin demo mode, seeding demo data and storing a fake admin profile in localStorage before navigating to the admin dashboard.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site-wide footer with branding, navigation links, social media icons, contact info, and a copyright notice with i18n support.
frontend/src/components/MessageInbox.tsx: Displays a two-panel messaging inbox that lists the user's conversations and shows messages for the selected conversation, with real-time polling and the ability to send new messages via a local store.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Renders the sticky top navigation bar with links, a language toggle, Internet Identity authentication, and a mobile menu, adapting display based on auth state and current route.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Shows a modal dialog prompting newly authenticated users to enter their full name and email to complete profile setup, skipping itself entirely in demo mode.
frontend/src/components/ReviewsSection.t: Displays a teacher's reviews with an average star rating, rating distribution bar chart, and individual review cards, polling the local store every 10 seconds.
frontend/src/components/ReviewSubmission: Renders a star-rating and text form that lets a student submit a review for a completed booking, saving it to the local reviews store and invalidating related queries on success.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetupModal: Modal dialog for admins to configure Stripe payments by entering a secret key and managing an allowed-countries list, saving the config via a backend actor mutation.
Full-screen overlay panel showing detailed profile information, performance metrics, and activity logs for a selected user, with demo-mode support.
frontend/src/components/UserManagementTa: Admin tab that lists all users with search and filter controls (role, status), supporting both live backend data and demo mode, and opens a UserDetailPanel on row click.
frontend/src/components/WeeklyAnalyticsT: Admin analytics tab rendering weekly snapshot data as summary stat cards and a Recharts bar chart, with the ability to generate a new snapshot for the current week.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient creation with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, activity logs, performance metrics, and weekly snapshots, with demo mode support returning seeded mock data.
frontend/src/hooks/useTimezone.ts: A small hook that returns the user's detected timezone and its abbreviation, memoized for performance.
frontend/src/i18n/en.ts: Contains the full English translation strings for the application, organized by feature sections such as navbar, footer, homepage, and teacher search.
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Re-exports the English and Tamil translation objects and the TranslationKeys type from their respective modules.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageContext.tsx: Provides a React context for language switching between English and Tamil, with localStorage persistence and a nested-key translation lookup function with English fallback.
frontend/src/i18n/ta.ts: Contains the full Tamil translation strings mirroring the English translation structure, covering navbar, footer, homepage, and other UI sections.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind, defines CSS custom properties for a teal/amber color palette in light and dark modes, and declares reusable component utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/localStore.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and localStorage-backed stores for client-side persistence of bookings, notifications, messages, conversations, reviews, blog posts, subscriptions, wallet entries, and referral codes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with TanStack QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider before mounting to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page with tabbed sections for managing bookings, withdrawals, users, analytics, and blog posts, supporting a demo mode that seeds sample data for display.
AI study assistant page that provides curriculum-specific study materials, quizzes, and study plans for multiple curricula (e.g., Tamil Nadu Samacheer Kalvi, CBSE), with detailed subject content maps and a tabbed UI.
frontend/src/pages/BlogListingPage.tsx: Blog listing page that fetches published posts from the local blog store and renders them as a responsive card grid with navigation to individual post pages.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPostPage.tsx: Individual blog post page that retrieves a post by slug from the local store and renders its content with basic markdown-like formatting, including a cover image and author metadata.
frontend/src/pages/DemoPage.tsx: An interactive multi-step demo page that walks users through key platform features (teacher search, profiles, student dashboard, booking, payments, AI tutor, etc.) using illustrated slides with navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/Homepage.tsx: The public-facing landing page displaying platform stats, feature highlights, how-it-works steps, and featured teachers, with CTAs to find a teacher or explore a demo.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: A payment failure page that reads an error message from URL params and presents options to retry the subscription purchase or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: A payment success page that verifies a Stripe session via the backend actor, updates the local subscription store on confirmation, and shows appropriate success or error UI.
frontend/src/pages/SessionRecordingsPage: A student-facing page listing completed bookings, separating sessions with and without recording URLs, and providing playback/external-link actions for available recordings.
frontend/src/pages/StudentDashboard.tsx: The main student dashboard showing upcoming and completed bookings, subscription status, referral link, pending reviews, and a message inbox, with a profile setup gate for new users.
frontend/src/pages/SubscriptionPackagesP: Displays available subscription packages with pricing and features, allowing users to subscribe via Stripe checkout or a demo mode that simulates the subscription locally.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherDashboard.tsx: Teacher dashboard showing upcoming/completed bookings, demo slot management, wallet balance, and referral link, with a profile setup gate for new teachers.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherProfilePage.ts: Public profile page for a teacher showing their details, available demo slots, reviews, and options to book a session or start a message conversation.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherSearchPage.tsx: Search and filter page for browsing teacher profiles by name, subject, language, and rating, fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherWalletPage.tsx: Teacher wallet page displaying available balance, total earnings, pending withdrawals, and a dialog to submit new withdrawal requests.
frontend/src/utils/formatTime.ts: Utility functions for formatting timestamps and dates into a user's local or specified timezone, including a helper to get the timezone abbreviation.
frontend/src/utils/seedDemoData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and a `seedDemoData` function that populates localStorage with demo users, bookings, reviews, messages, subscriptions, activity logs, performance metrics, and weekly snapshots for an Admin Demo session.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, persisting them to sessionStorage, and clearing sensitive parameters from the URL without a page reload.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, while enabling the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state (version 35) for Pristine Learning, a global tutoring marketplace, documenting the tech stack, architectural notes, known bugs, and the full list of implemented features across all versions.
